source.author: Xukun Zhang et al.
source.label_convention: Source IDs 1–8 displayed as I–VIII; IV is not subdivided.
source.processing: Per-label scalar smoothing sigma 0.6 mm and marching cubes at 0.5, native voxel grid/affine; Taubin 8 iterations (lambda=0.5, nu=0.5); quadric decimation (aggression 5), initial targets 7000 faces/segment and 14000 whole surface, doubled as needed to retain closed surfaces; joint uniform normalization; 5 decimal places.
